in_marathi.name: मारोती
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mother of Maruts
in_marathi.long_meaning: मारोती हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name मारोती (Mārōtī) is derived from Sanskrit words ‘Mārā’ (Maruts) and ‘Tī’ (Mother). This name signifies the mother of the Maruts, a group of wind gods in Hindu mythology. Maruts were believed to bring rain and prosperity, and their mother was revered as the goddess of fertility and abundance.
